jobs.description_text:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Forward Deployed AI Engineer to work directly with client engineering teams, manage multiple concurrent projects, and drive technical solutions that extend beyond our core platform offering. This is a client-facing, hands-on technical role that combines deep AI expertise with business acumen to deliver results on tight timelines while building lasting client relationships. While we are a remote-first company, the nature of this role requires candidates to be based in the Singapore area.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with enterprise AI teams to design, implement, and scale production-grade GenAI observability and evaluation programs.
  • Lead technical discussions with customer stakeholders ranging from engineers to senior executives, translating business priorities into scalable technical solutions.
  • Build custom integrations, tooling, and workflows that extend the Arize platform to meet customer-specific requirements.
  • Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, driving projects from scoping through delivery while maintaining a high bar for technical execution and customer experience.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering teams to shape implementation strategy, influence product direction, and expand customer impact.
  • Help define and scale best practices, technical playbooks, and delivery methodologies for the growing Forward Deployed Engineering team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Software Development: 2-5 years of hands-on software development experience with strong technical foundations. We work extensively in Python, Java, and TypeScript, and expect candidates to be comfortable working in at least two of those languages.
  • ML/AI Engineering: Experience building MLOps pipelines and/or developing, deploying, and iterating on Generative AI applications in production environments..
  • Cloud Technologies: Experience working with public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) as well as containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes).
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across both technical and business audiences. You should be comfortable engaging with senior executives on business outcomes and metrics, collaborating with engineers on technical implementation details, and translating seamlessly between the two.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple client engineering engagements simultaneously and deliver high-quality technical outcomes under demanding timelines.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable operating in fast-paced startup or consulting environments, with the ability to navigate diverse client organizations, technical stacks, and evolving priorities.
  • Passion for AI: We live and breathe AI at Arize. The strongest candidates are genuinely excited about the space and energized by staying at the forefront of rapidly evolving AI technologies.

Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/arize-ai-hopes-it-has-first-mover-advantage-in-ai-observability/

https://arize.com/blog/arize-ai-raises-70m-series-c-to-build-the-gold-standard-for-ai-evaluation-observability/

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

We are seeking a Research Data Scientist who combines rigorous research thinking with a drive to see findings land in production.

This is a research-first role at the intersection of post-training alignment & reasoning, efficient inference and test-time scaling, and multi-agent coordination in adversarial financial environments.

You will conduct original research that pushes the boundaries of what AI agents can do — reasoning under market uncertainty, coordinating with other agents in open adversarial settings, and making reliable decisions when real value is at stake. The goal is real-world impact: agents that trade, analyze, and act for millions of users across the Binance ecosystem.

  • Conduct original research in generative AI and large language models applied to crypto and financial domains — focus areas include reasoning under market uncertainty, alignment of trading agents, multi-agent coordination, and test-time scaling for time-critical decisions

  • Develop novel post-training methodologies and evaluation frameworks for LLMs operating in crypto contexts — covering chain-of-thought quality for market analysis, agent decision consistency, and robustness against adversarial prompt injection
  • Research test-time scaling techniques — process reward models, self-consistency, Monte Carlo Tree Search-based planning — and apply them to improve agent reasoning quality in ambiguous, fast-moving market conditions
  • Critically track developments across the research community at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, and crypto-adjacent venues — identifying high-leverage opportunities to apply state-of-the-art techniques to Binance's unique challenges

Requirements

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; exceptional Bachelor's candidates with demonstrable research output will be considered

  • Deep understanding of transformer architectures, large language model pretraining dynamics, and post-training methodology — including RLHF, RLVR-based reasoning model training, and alignment techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and PyTorch
  • Rigorous mathematical foundations: linear algebra, probability theory, information theory, stochastic optimization
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders
  • First-author publications at top-tier AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, AAAI) on LLM/Agent core topics — reasoning, multi-agent systems, RL for LLMs, post-training, agent memory, or related areas
  • Research or engineering experience at a top-tier AI lab or team

Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs powering compliance and analytics products
  • Own features end to end, from technical design through deployment and monitoring
  • Build data pipelines that ingest, normalise, and index on-chain activity across multiple blockchains
  • Contribute to the architecture of new compliance capabilities — you'll be in the room where the approach gets decided, not handed the outcome
  • Model data and optimise queries against relational and NoSQL stores at scale
  • Work directly with compliance and product specialists to translate regulatory requirements into technical design
  • Improve reliability, observability, and performance of services already in production
  • Use AI-assisted development tooling as part of your normal workflow to raise output quality and speed


Requirements:

  • 3+ years building production backend systems in Java
  • Strong command of Spring Boot, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and memory behaviour
  • Solid SQL and data modelling; practical experience diagnosing slow queries
  • Experience designing and operating web-facing services at scale — request handling, caching, rate limiting, idempotency
  • Working proficiency in both Chinese and English, spoken and written
  • Fluent, daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex, with a clear view of where they help and where they need supervision
  • Comfortable owning code you did not write, and reading unfamiliar codebases quickly
  • Genuine interest in the problem space — compliance products reward engineers who care why a rule exists, not only what it says



Preferred:

  • A self-starting, exploratory mindset — you investigate problems before being asked to, and you go looking for the answer rather than waiting for a ticket
  • A willingness to contribute to how the industry develops, and to speak up with constructive proposals when you see a better way — we want engineers who challenge the design, not only implement it
  • AWS in production: ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, SQS, IAM, CloudWatch
  • Blockchain or crypto exposure — node RPC integration, on-chain data indexing, wallet or transaction infrastructure
  • Kafka or similar streaming platforms
  • Prior work in a regulated environment: financial services, payments, AML/KYC, or RegTech
  • Familiarity with FATF Travel Rule, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring concepts

    Why this role


    Web3 compliance is one of the few areas where the engineering problem and the regulatory problem are genuinely unsolved together. The products you build here are used by exchanges, VASPs, and regulators, and the design choices you make have reach well beyond a single codebase. If you want work where the technical difficulty and the significance are both real, this is that.
